description: This file defines a React component called ServicesPage that manages and displays a list of connector services. It includes state management for services, loading status, errors, and actions to start/stop services via API calls. It also renders a table with service details and action buttons.

methods.name: ServicesPage
methods.description: React functional component that renders the services management UI and handles interactions.

methods.name: toMessage
methods.description: Converts various error types to string messages for display.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest list of services from the API and updates the state.

methods.name: handleStart
methods.description: Starts a specified service by its ID, updates state and refreshes the list.

methods.name: handleStop
methods.description: Stops a specified service by its ID, updates state and refreshes the list.
